about: Every use of the mark, with the kit file it is byte for byte (checked by SHA-256 in tests/acceptance/79), the point size the D is shown at, and the screenshot that proves it. px is the D's height in points; a PNG's height is px times scale.

surfaces.note: Embedded by crates/deep-app/src/brand.rs and set on the running app as its dock icon; there is no .app bundle yet. The shot is the running app's tile, cropped from a screen capture at 2x.

The status item's template image at 1x, tinted by macOS. The shot is the item's own window captured by window id at 2x, as macOS drew it, laid on the menu bar's sampled colour: the reference Mac's notched bar was full, so macOS hid the item in the bar itself.
The same image's 2x representation; the same shot.
The small cut in Ink, drawn by the window's own title bar. The shot is the running app's window captured by window id at 2x, cropped to the bar's left end.
The stacked lockup in Ink on Paper where no panel is mounted. The shot is the same window capture, cropped to the right pane.

deep --help reads the file and sends it inline where the terminal identifies as iTerm2 or kitty; text alone elsewhere or when piped. The shot is Ghostty, which draws kitty's graphics protocol, run with TERM=xterm-kitty since neither iTerm2 nor kitty is on the reference Mac; captured by window id at 2x and cropped to the banner.
